description: Render the care-needs UI using the FEAT-001 pure helpers: add a hunger/fullness gauge row to StatsPanel (mirroring the HP bar), wire the HP-aware moodLabel, enhance the sprite-adjacent state badges (new hunger badge + existing dirty 💢 / sleeping 💤) with a caution color near threshold that is NOT color-only (icon + aria-label/title), add JA+EN i18n keys, and style everything in styles.css respecting prefers-reduced-motion. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: In packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts, add new keys to JA_MESSAGES (source of truth) AND matching entries to EN_MESSAGES (Record<MessageKey,string>, so both are required or the build fails). Suggested keys: `stats.fullness` -> JA '満腹度' / EN 'Fullness' (gauge label); `badge.hungry` -> JA 'お腹がすいている' / EN 'Hungry' (hunger badge aria-label/title); `badge.dirty` -> JA 'よごれている' / EN 'Dirty' (dirty badge aria-label, to make the existing 💢 perceivable without color); `badge.sleeping` -> JA '睡眠中' / EN 'Sleeping' (sleeping badge aria-label for 💤). Keep JA strings concise and natural; keep existing keys untouched.

In packages/frontend/src/components/StatsPanel.tsx, import fullnessPercent and isHungerCaution from ../ui-helpers.ts. Compute `const fullness = fullnessPercent(monster.hungryLevel)` and `const hungerCaution = isHungerCaution(monster.hungryLevel)`. Add a new .stat-row for fullness, placed directly after the HP row and before ATK, mirroring the HP bar structure: {t('stats.fullness')} +
+ a readout showing both the percent and the raw level, e.g. `${fullness}%` plus `(${monster.hungryLevel}/${MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL})` using MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL imported from '@ddm/shared' (do not hardcode 10). When hungerCaution, add role/aria so the caution is announced, e.g. aria-label on the row combining t('stats.fullness') and t('badge.hungry'); do not rely on the red color alone.

Update the mood line in StatsPanel: pass the full monster (now including stats) to moodLabel so the HP-aware branch works — moodLabel(monster, lang) already receives the monster; ensure the widened type from FEAT-001 is satisfied (monster.stats is present). No string change to t('stats.mood') prefix.

In packages/frontend/src/App.tsx, enhance the sprite-adjacent badges inside .sprite-wrap. Keep the existing {isSleeping && 💤} and {dirty && 💢} but add accessible labels: give each badge span a role='img' and aria-label/title from the new i18n keys (badge.sleeping, badge.dirty) instead of aria-hidden, OR keep the emoji aria-hidden and add a visually-hidden text label — pick one consistent accessible approach so each state is perceivable without color. Add a NEW hunger badge rendered when isHungerCaution(monster.hungryLevel) is true (import the helper), e.g. 🍖 (or a hunger emoji such as 🍽️). Position it so it does not overlap the 💤/💢 badges.

In packages/frontend/src/styles.css: add `.bar-fill.fullness` with a distinct non-red gradient (e.g. amber/green) for the normal state, and `.bar-fill.fullness.caution` with a caution color (e.g. red/orange) used only when near threshold. Add styles for the new `.sprite-wrap .hunger-badge` (absolute position like .zzz/.dirt but not overlapping — e.g. a different corner), and a `.caution` treatment for badges. Ensure the caution cue pairs color with the emoji icon + aria-label (already added in markup). If you add any pulsing/animation to the caution badge, gate it inside an existing-style `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block that disables the animation.

If the dirty/sleeping badge markup changed from aria-hidden to role=img with aria-label (or added visually-hidden labels), add a `.visually-hidden` utility class in styles.css if you chose that approach and it does not already exist.

Run the full verification: `npm run build` at root (green; tsc enforces i18n key parity and the moodLabel signature), `npm test` at root (shared 47/47), and `cd packages/frontend && npm test` (all pass).

Optionally run `npm run dev` and use the playwright Kiro Power to confirm: the fullness gauge renders and depletes as hungryLevel rises, the gauge + hunger badge turn the caution color at hungryLevel >= HUNGRY_CAUTION_LEVEL, and the badges expose aria-labels. Toggle JA/EN to confirm both languages render.
acceptance_criteria: StatsPanel shows a labeled fullness gauge (mirroring the HP bar) with a numeric/level readout, representing hungryLevel 0..10 as full->hungry, sourced from fullnessPercent + MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL (no hardcoded cap).
When hungryLevel >= HUNGRY_CAUTION_LEVEL, the fullness gauge and the sprite-adjacent hunger badge show a caution color AND retain an icon + accessible aria-label/title (not color-only).
Sprite-adjacent badges for hunger (new), dirty (💢), and sleeping (💤) each have an accessible label (role=img + aria-label/title or a visually-hidden label); the mood line uses the HP-aware moodLabel.
All new user-visible strings have both ja and en i18n entries (build passes, proving key parity).
`npm run build` is green, `npm test` keeps shared at 47/47, and `cd packages/frontend && npm test` passes.
Any added animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; change is frontend-only (plus the FEAT-001 shared const export) with no backend/infra edits.
findings: Implemented frontend-only. i18n.ts: added stats.fullness (満腹度/Fullness), badge.hungry (お腹がすいている/Hungry), badge.dirty (よごれている/Dirty), badge.sleeping (睡眠中/Sleeping) to BOTH JA_MESSAGES and EN_MESSAGES (key parity enforced by tsc). StatsPanel.tsx: imports fullnessPercent/isHungerCaution (ui-helpers) and MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL (@ddm/shared); new fullness .stat-row inserted after HP and before ATK, mirroring the HP bar (.stat-label + .bar>.bar-fill fullness[ caution] width ${fullness}% + .stat-value readout `${fullness}% (${hungryLevel}/${MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL})`). When isHungerCaution, the row gets a combined aria-label `${t('stats.fullness')}: ${t('badge.hungry')}` so caution is announced, not color-only. Mood line unchanged (moodLabel already HP-aware via FEAT-001). App.tsx: existing 💤/💢 spans switched from aria-hidden to role='img' + aria-label/title (badge.sleeping / badge.dirty); NEW hunger badge 🍖 rendered when isHungerCaution(monster.hungryLevel), className 'hunger-badge caution', role='img', aria-label+title=t('badge.hungry'). styles.css: .bar-fill.fullness (amber->green) and .bar-fill.fullness.caution (orange->red); .sprite-wrap .hunger-badge positioned bottom-right (bottom:14px right:18px) so it does not overlap .zzz (top-right) or .dirt (top-left); caution adds a drop-shadow glow + hunger-badge-pulse animation, which is disabled inside a new @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block. No .visually-hidden class needed (used role=img+aria-label/title approach consistently). Caution threshold behavior: gauge fill turns orange/red AND the 🍖 badge appears at hungryLevel >= HUNGRY_CAUTION_LEVEL (7). Verification: root `npm run build` GREEN (tsc i18n key parity + moodLabel signature compile OK), root `npm test` shared 47/47 PASS, frontend `npm test` 55/55 PASS. No shared/src edits so no shared rebuild needed.
